author: The Current
description:
Duluth singer/songwriter Sophie Hiroko stopped by The Current's Morning Show and shared about her connection to the band Trampled by Turtles.

Sophie Hiroko will be performing at 7th St Entry tonight Friday, August 7 featuring Lana Leone, Scrunchies, and Ava Levy. 

Find out more about upcoming shows at thecurrent.org/giglist
